The runtime code of the Coinbase Smart Wallet contracts and of the ERC4337 EntryPoint v0.6 they use, as hex,
loaded by test/unit/deploy/RealCoinbaseWallet.t.sol.

Each file is the eth_getCode answer at its address on OP Mainnet (chain 10) at finalized block 159074208
(3 November 2026, 23:06:33 UTC) from mainnet.optimism.io, read on 4 November 2026. Its keccak256 equals the code
hash that node gives for the address at that block (eth_getProof), and the keccak256 of the code at the latest block
from optimism-rpc.publicnode.com and 1rpc.io/op. The same code is at the same addresses on Base (mainnet.base.org)
and Ethereum (ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com).

The factory and wallet addresses are the ones the github.com/coinbase/smart-wallet README lists for versions 1 and
1.1, and the ones its script/DeployFactory.s.sol checks at tags v1.0.0 and v1.1.0. On OP Mainnet implementation()
of each factory names its wallet, and entryPoint() of both wallets names the EntryPoint v0.6. The EntryPoint makes
each new account through the SenderCreator it deployed, whose address is an immutable in the EntryPoint code.

file               contract                          address                                     keccak256

wallet.hex         CoinbaseSmartWallet 1             0x000100abaad02f1cfC8Bbe32bD5a564817339E72  0x179bcb847d3401ac830789a21cc37ed846fd5da9582a9c9d4b5140b6f26bd1a1
factory11.hex      CoinbaseSmartWalletFactory 1.1    0xBA5ED110eFDBa3D005bfC882d75358ACBbB85842  0xb60a629aa7c6af9b550871fd21b67ab84638156683cec68491049cb5d235ed2f

entrypoint.hex     EntryPoint v0.6                   0x5FF137D4b0FDCD49DcA30c7CF57E578a026d2789  0xc93c806e738300b5357ecdc2e971d6438d34d8e4e17b99b758b1f9cac91c8e70
sendercreator.hex  SenderCreator of EntryPoint v0.6  0x7fc98430eaedbb6070b35b39d798725049088348  0xae818091eaaf1b6175ee41472359a689f3823d0908a41e2e5c4ad508f2fc04a3

Every wallet the two factories make is the same 61 byte ERC1967 proxy, which the test checks against this code hash.
It is the code hash at that block of 0xcdf8cf9a63cde607d5eab61505e14e9e44ea2198 and
0x64e689baa6cb797f12832d15bc37306e2bc23083, made by factory 1, and of 0x8da6eb943b81777da1a13551e86606950ae85f3b,
made by factory 1.1, all found through the AccountDeployed events of the EntryPoint on OP Mainnet.

proxy              ERC1967 proxy of each wallet                                                  0xaaa52c8cc8a0e3fd27ce756cc6b4e70c51423e9b597b11f32d3e49f8b1fc890d
